summary: Nova Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Notice of Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and proxy statement for the 2026 AGM to be held on June 18, 2026. The agenda covers routine items: re-election and election of directors, approval of CEO employment terms and compensation policy, reappointment of auditors, and consideration of audited financials. The filing discloses standard Israeli corporate governance requirements for proposal submissions. No special situation, transaction, or strategic event is present; this is a routine regulatory compliance filing for an annual shareholder meeting.
